  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  COUNCIL
  CITY COUNCIL

  REGULAR MEETING

  TUESDAY, JULY 28, 2020 AT 6:00 PM

CALL TO ORDER

The regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to
order by Mayor Jesse Alvarado on Tuesday, July 28, 2020, at 6:04 PM in the City
Council Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

Lucie Colombo, CMC, City Clerk, provided brief information relating to the conduct of
the virtual video meeting due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation, as listed on the
agenda.

INVOCATION
Lucie Colombo led the invocation.
FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Pro Tem Roa.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  MAYOR  JESSE ALVARADO
  MAYOR PRO TEM  LUIS ROA
  COUNCILMEMBER  VICTOR FARFAN
  COUNCILMEMBER  MYRA MARAVILLA
  COUNCILMEMBER  HANK TRIMBLE

Lucie Colombo, CMC, CPMC, announced a quorum.

The City Clerk provided information relating to the conduct of the General Public
Comment and Public Hearing Public Comment sections to follow for the virtual video
conference meeting as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic situation.

PROCLAMATIONS AND CERTIFICATES

There were no Proclamations and Certificates at this time.

PRESENTATIONS

Video presentation on the Food Drive Giveaway and update on Lee Ware Pool.

A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(S) - NONE

B.  CONSENT CALENDAR
Items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one
motion and one vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion
is desired, that item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and will be considered
separately.

The City Council, upon approval of the Consent Calendar will waive reading in full of all
ordinances and resolutions on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on
the public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading
waived.

10.  RESOLUTION NO. 063-2020
  APPROVING SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE MEMORANDUM OF
  UNDERSTANDING (MOU) BETWEEN THE LOS ANGELES REGIONAL
  INTEGRATED WATER MANAGEMENT JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY (JPA)
  AND THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS FOR ADMINISTRATION AND
  MANAGEMENT PROGRAM (“WMP”) AND COORDINATED INTEGRATED
  MONITORING PROGRAM (“CIMP”) AS REQUIRED BY THE REGIONAL
  WATER QUALITY CONTROL BOARD, LOS ANGELES REGION, NATIONAL
  POLLUTANT DISCHARGE ELIMINATION SYSTEM MUNICIPAL SEPARATE
  STORM SEWER SYSTEM PERMIT ORDER NO. R4-2012-0175 AND
  SUBSEQUENT MUNICIPAL SEPARATE STORM SEWER SYSTEMS (“MS4
  PERMIT”).

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Adopt Resolution No. 063-2020.

It was moved by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Trimble and
approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt the Consent Calendar in its entirety.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  NONE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.

 C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

11.  RESOLUTION NO. 064-2020
  APPROVING A REQUEST BY THE PACIFIC GARDENS MEDICAL CENTER
  TO ALLOW AN ADDITIONAL NINETY-DAY EXTENSION OF THE TIME
  PERIOD ALLOWED FOR A TEMPORARY INTERRUPTION OF USE
  ASSOCIATED WITH EXISTING ENTITLEMENTS FOR THE HOSPITAL
  OPERATION LOCATION AT 21530 PIONEER BOULEVARD, HAWAIIAN
  GARDENS.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Adopt Resolution No. 064-2020.

Joe Colombo, Community and Development Director, presented the staff report.

Representatives from Pacific Gardens Medical Center spoke.

Councilmember Maravilla spoke, Councilmember Trimble, Councilmember Farfan, and
Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

It was moved by Councilmember Trimble, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Roa and
approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt Resolution No. 064-2020.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  NONE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.

12.  DISCUSSION REGARDING COVID-19 EMERGENCY ASSISTANCE
  PROGRAMS.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Provide staff direction.

There were presentations on the Residential Rental Assistance Program, COVID-19
Business assistance Economic Relief Program, and COVID-19 Community Food Drive
and Supply Distribution Program.

All City Councilmembers spoke.

Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, spoke.

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, spoke.

Joe Colombo spoke.

Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services, spoke.

Direction was given to staff to bring back item with program guidelines, set subsidy
limits for different income category groups.

 D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

Councilmember Maravilla requested to schedule a Law Enforcement Committee

E.  NEW BUSINESS

Councilmember Trimble requested to discuss the financial difference between Youth
Sports and Adult Sports at the next City Council Meeting.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services Director, made comments
regarding Lee Ware Pool and the Splash Pad.

Joe Colombo, Community Development Director made comments regarding the
completion of the LED lights.

Councilmember Maravilla thanked Joe Colombo regarding the LED lights.

Lucie Colombo, City Clerk, made comments regarding voting.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Alvarado spoke.

Councilmember Maravilla spoke.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session Items at this time.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

Mayor Alvarado adjourned the meeting at approximately 7:49 PM to the next Regular
City Council meeting to be held on Tuesday, August 11, 2020 at 6:00 PM.
